steps.caption: Locations
steps.narration: This is Locations. Every Google Business Profile you manage sits in one list, synced from Google every six hours.

steps.caption: Search, filter, scroll
steps.narration: Search the list, filter it by client or status, and scroll to the listing you want.

steps.caption: Rating, reviews, category, quick links
steps.narration: Each row shows the rating and review count, the primary category, and quick links to call, get directions, open the website and read reviews.

steps.caption: Eight tabs per location
steps.narration: The location opens on Insights. Eight tabs run down the side, from Insights to Citations.

steps.caption: Insights: Google's performance report
steps.narration: Insights is the performance report Google shares for a verified listing.

steps.caption: Views, clicks, calls, directions
steps.narration: Search and Maps views on mobile and desktop, plus website clicks, call clicks and directions.

steps.caption: By day, week or month
steps.narration: Group it by day, week or month, from the last thirty days to all stored history.

steps.caption: Location Info
steps.narration: Location Info is the profile as Google has it.

steps.caption: Name, address, phone, website, hours
steps.narration: Name, description, address, service areas, phone, website, hours and open status.

steps.caption: Services and categories
steps.narration: Services lists every service and category on the listing, primary category marked. Edit them in Google Business Profile and they update here on the next sync.

steps.caption: Profile Watch
steps.narration: Profile Watch, the edit alert, has its own tab on every linked listing. It gets its own video.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: You'll find Locations in the menu on the left, under Google Business.

youtube.title: Google Business Profile in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Locations in ConstructHUB: every Google Business Profile you manage in one list, each with Google's performance figures, the profile details and services as Google has them, a citation checklist and its own Profile Watch tab, synced from Google every six hours.
